items.stem: A churn model flags a customer as high-risk. What is the responsible next step?

options.text: Review the recommendation for fairness and accuracy before acting
options.rationale: Correct: churn scores can be biased or wrong and need review.
Acting blindly on a score can harm customers unfairly.

options.text: Assume the score is always correct
options.rationale: Models can be wrong or biased.

options.text: Ignore privacy rules when using the data
options.rationale: Privacy rules still apply to customer data.

items.stem: Which TWO practices support responsible AI use in telecom? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Use customer and network data within privacy and security rules
options.rationale: Correct: lawful, secure data use protects customers and the operator.

options.text: Monitor models for bias and reliability over time
options.rationale: Correct: ongoing oversight catches drift and unfair outcomes.

options.text: Share raw customer data with any vendor on request
options.rationale: Uncontrolled sharing breaches privacy and security.

options.text: Deploy models once and never review them

items.explanation: Correct: lawful, secure data use protects customers and the operator.

options.text: Alerts can be false positives or point to the wrong cause
options.rationale: Correct: verification avoids acting on misleading alerts.

options.text: Root cause never matters for action
options.rationale: Correct action depends on the real cause.

options.text: Verification wastes time with no benefit
